messages:
Priya (RevOps): Heads-up — spike in unassigned inbound leads for EMEA at 09:02UTC. HubSpot shows enrichment requests pending; SF handoff sometimes creates "queued" with no owner. Can we quick sync?
Ethan (Growth): Saw a drop in owner assignment rate and CTR on outreach emails. Any immediate mitigation ideas?
Leo (Eng): Early log notes: enrichment service sometimes returns partial payload (missing contact_info) -> our RR filter excludes those leads. Also HS retries are aggressive and riding into throttles.
Casey (Ops): cadence-bot alerted at 09:05UTC: "unassigned_rate > 0.025 for inbound-emea" :rotating_light:
Priya (RevOps): Proposed temporary workflow: route incomplete-enrichment leads into a "triage-queue" (not assigned to SDRs) for 30m; automated re-check at 30m to try mapping again; if still incomplete, assign to fallback-pool with a 'needs-enrichment' tag. This avoids noisy false-assignments.
Leo (Eng): Implementation sketch: add routing rule: if enrichment.payload.contact_info == null -> state=triage_queue ttl=1800s tag=needs_enrichment. Heartbeat checks triage_queue every 60s to re-request enrichment up to 3 attempts. Pseudo:
```
if (!payload.contact_info) {
  setState('triage_queue');
  ttl=1800; tag='needs_enrichment';
}
```
Ethan (Growth): Nice — reduces SDR context-switching. But dashboard/SLAs need clarity: triage-queue leads are "not owned" but monitored. We'll want a banner + Slack digest for triage hits.
Casey (Ops): Observability: add metrics: triage_queue_rate, triage_recover_pct (within 24h), triage_to_fallback_rate. Alert if triage_queue_rate > 1.5% for 20m. Also include source-region breakdown.
Priya (RevOps): Comms/playbook for SDRs (short): "Leads in 'triage' may lack enrichment. Do not reach out until 'assigned'. If you see fallback-pool owner assignment, follow this checklist: 1) verify contact, 2) mark enrichment resolved or reassign. Link to playbook: <doc link>."
Leo (Eng): Back-end changes: add x-hs-retrycount header, cap webhook concurrency, and add circuit-breaker for HS per-region. Also propose a soft-rr-fallback: after triage TTL, if enrichment still missing, push to a small dedicated fallback-pool instead of full RR. Will add feature flag routing.triage.enabled for canary.
Ethan (Growth): For metrics we'll track: owner_assign_latency_p50/p95, triage_queue_size, percent_emails_sent_to_fallback. Want a weekly report for any SLA regressions.
Casey (Ops): Rollout plan: feature flag on -> staging smoke -> canary 5% traffic for 3 hours -> monitor triage_recover_pct and owner_assign_latency. If triage_recover_pct < 60% after 24h, rollback.
Priya (RevOps): Also ensure SF mapping script won't create duplicates when triage resolves. Add a dedupe check on SF upsert.
cadence-bot: Incident created: "EMEA enrichment incomplete payloads -> triage queue enabled (flag)" id:INC-171920. :white_check_mark:
Leo (Eng): I'll open PR with tests and a migration for tags. Tagging @Priya for rollout checklist. ETA for canary today 16:00UTC.
Ethan (Growth): I'll prepare the SDR banner + one-pager noting this is a behavioral change (triage first, fallback later).
Priya (RevOps): Great. Post-canary we should sample 50 triage leads and check whether enrichment later filled fields and conversion behavior. Keep updates here (PR link, dashboard tile). Thanks team.
